build_simple_vit_3d: build a 3D Vision Transformer model for video classification with configurable patch size, frames, and dimensions
build_transformer_layers: build a transformer encoder stack with multi-head attention and feed-forward layers
build_attention_module: build a multi-head self-attention module with query-key-value projections and softmax
build_feed_forward_network: build a feed-forward network with layer normalization, linear layers, and GELU activation
generate_3d_positional_embeddings: generate 3D sinusoidal positional embeddings for video patches across frame, height, and width dimensions
